When does New Year 2027 start in Nigeria?

Nigeria uses a single time zone on New Year's Eve, UTC+01:00, so the whole country welcomes 2027 at the same moment: midnight local time corresponds to 23:00 UTC on Thursday, December 31, 2026.

New Year's Day 2027 falls on a Friday.

Nigeria in the global New Year countdown

The first places on Earth to enter 2027 are the Line Islands of Kiribati (UTC+14:00). Lagos follows 13 hours later, and the last inhabited places, American Samoa and Niue (UTC-11:00), celebrate 12 hours after Lagos.

When the clock strikes midnight in Lagos, 100 of the 196 countries in our world time zone table already have at least one region celebrating 2027.

  • Just before (UTC+02:00): Egypt, Greece, Russia (Kaliningrad), South Africa, Botswana, Bulgaria, Burundi, Cyprus and 21 more
  • Just after (UTC+00:00): Ireland, Portugal (Lisbon), Spain (Canary Islands), United Kingdom, Burkina Faso, Côte d'Ivoire, Gambia, Ghana and 10 more

Who celebrates at the same time as Nigeria?

These countries also reach midnight at UTC+01:00, so they welcome 2027 at exactly the same moment as Lagos: France, Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Poland, Spain (Madrid), Sweden, Albania, Algeria, Andorra, Angola, Austria and 31 more.

Frequently asked questions

What time is New Year 2027 in Nigeria in UTC?

Midnight in Lagos corresponds to 23:00 UTC on Thursday, December 31, 2026.

How many time zones does Nigeria have on New Year's Eve?

One. The whole country uses UTC+01:00 on New Year's Eve.

Is daylight saving time in effect in Nigeria on New Year's Eve?

No. Lagos keeps UTC+01:00 all year round.

Which countries celebrate New Year just before Nigeria?

The previous time zone to reach midnight is UTC+02:00, which includes Egypt, Greece, Russia (Kaliningrad), South Africa, Botswana, Bulgaria, Burundi, Cyprus and 21 more.
